summary.name: Microsoft Teams (free)
summary.one_liner: Microsoft's free consumer version of Teams for starting video calls and online meetings, with chat, screen sharing, and file sharing.
use_cases: hosting free video calls with friends or family
running small business or freelancer meetings
teacher or PTA group video calls
collaborating on documents during a call
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes a free version of Microsoft Teams for starting video calls and online meetings. It lists 60-minute free meetings, shareable meeting links that work across devices, and screen sharing. Live captions are offered in over 40 languages. It also mentions file sharing, chat themes, and shared activities such as games and shopping together. Meeting recording and AI features through Microsoft Copilot are listed as paid features.
notable: Shareable meeting links that work on any device
Shared activities such as games and shopping during calls
caveats: Meeting recording is a paid feature
AI features require Microsoft Copilot, a paid feature
Free meetings are limited to 60 minutes
